title: Penguin Panic slides onto Nintendo Switch!
body:
Get ready to waddle, jump, and save those eggs—Penguin Panic is now available on the Nintendo Switch! Our fast-paced, family-friendly platformer has finally flapped its way onto your favorite console.

 

Nintendo Switch

Join Mama Penguin on her chilly quest across 17 colorful worlds to rescue her stolen eggs from the evil walruses. Dash through icy caves, bounce over walrus heads, and race against time in this retro-style adventure inspired by 8-bit classics.

Whether you’re playing docked or handheld, Penguin Panic delivers pure, frosty fun for all ages.

❄️ Available now on the Nintendo eShop.
🐧 Waddle fast. Jump high. Save your eggs. Panic responsibly.

Buy now »
